prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent PNG Warrior Attack sprite, same 1448x1086 canvas and character scale as image 1.
Image 1 is the actual Warrior READY frame, identity/costume/weapon/design reference. Generate its CONNECTED ATTACK frame, not another ready pose.
Image 2 is physical reference only: one-handed sword and buckler, the grey-haired man on the RIGHT of figures 23 and 24 shows a forehand descending cut. Image 3 is motion reference only: actual diagonal cut intermediate follow-through, shoulder moving forward/down and ribcage rotating. Image 4 is line/shape style authority; don't copy its costume.
Action: a forceful inward right-handed descending forehand cut from the sword raised over the right shoulder in READY, through front of body toward character's LEFT. Capture just after impact while the blade is still high enough to read, not a deep low finish.
The CORE correction is body mechanics: rotate the chest/shoulder girdle LEFT with the cut and lean slightly forward-left. The RIGHT shoulder must visibly advance and DROP from its raised Ready position; the same two-rivet pauldron turns and foreshortens attached to that anatomical shoulder. It MUST NOT stay parked high on screen-right as if still winding up. Left shoulder and cloak respond to the torso twist. Helmet stays near Ready's head position or slightly left, never displaced right. Preserve waist registration.
Right arm follows shoulder forward, elbow leads through front of ribs, hand ends toward the LEFT front of upper abdomen/lower chest. Correct normal hammer grip: blade exits thumb/index side of fist, pommel exits little-finger side. Large original broad longsword remains full size, blade projects screen-left at a shallow downward angle, prominently visible beside upper-body silhouette; not buried below waist. Natural rear three-quarter view with torso rotation so the right arm's forward action and sensible occlusion read; never draw forearm across the BACK, no floating sword by neck. Left hand still bears original wooden shield, separate from sword hand, on anatomical left; do not mirror the character.
Retain original iron helmet, ochre neck cloth, ragged olive cloak, dark armor, two-rivet shoulder plate and wooden shield design. Bold slightly irregular black outlines, broad flat angular shadow shapes, restrained earthy colors, compact body. No extra armor, extra arms, magic or motion streaks. No text, ground, background, panels or reference figures. True transparent background. Single sprite only.

Edit image 1 (original READY Warrior) into its next ATTACK frame. Image 2 is the physical follow-through reference only (right-hand swordsman on right of photos 23/24), not camera orientation or costume. Keep the EXACT camera side and anatomical handedness of image 1. Do not mirror!
Canvas 1448x1086 transparent; single rear-view waist-up game character. Original shield remains screen-LEFT in his LEFT hand. Sword remains his RIGHT hand, cutting from high screen-right READY to screen-left. Helmet center stays around x650, y200, never goes to the right side of canvas. Waist centered x700, y800. Original scale.
REDRAW body mechanics, not just sword: shoulder line slopes down toward sword arm; right shoulder drops from raised high READY to chest level around x850,y470. Right shoulder remains on the right side of the neck but is LOWER and pushed forward into the cut. Torso twists toward LEFT and leans slightly LEFT; back cloak folds diagonally with that twist. Same two-rivet right shoulder plate rotates down with shoulder, never stays raised like Ready, never migrates to anatomical LEFT.
Right upper arm extends FORWARD around side of chest (away from rear-view camera), elbow comes in/down in front of torso. Forearm runs across FRONT of body, occluded by chest from our rear view, NOT a bar across his BACK. The RIGHT gloved sword hand emerges outside the LEFT torso silhouette around x440,y520, clearly separate and higher than shield hand. Let body rotation and occlusion be natural. Left arm holds shield on left around x180,y750, not right. Only two arms.
Sword: full-sized broad iron blade, normal hammer grip (blade from thumb/index, pommel below little finger). Hilt at left chest, blade extends LEFT and slightly DOWN toward x40,y680, very shallow diagonal, entirely readable alongside upper body, not deep below waist. Attack should feel like a forceful slash with torso and shoulder carrying the arm through, not a sword held still.
Identity unchanged: original iron helmet/ochre scarf/ragged olive cloak/dark armor/two-rivet shoulder plate/wooden shield. Same angular broad flat shading and bold black outline. Preserve original compact torso proportions and restrained palette. No props, arrows, speed trails, text or panels. True transparent background.

Redraw this READY sprite as its connected ATTACK. Same character, same canvas and same registration: helmet centered at x650, waist x700 on 1448x1086. Keep shield LEFT; never mirror.
He has just slashed his right-hand sword from above his right shoulder inward toward LEFT. His entire upper torso now turns LEFT, head leaning LEFT, not right. The RIGHT shoulder lowers and rolls FORWARD, becoming a narrow foreshortened shoulder on the RIGHT of the neck, partly occluded by neck/cloak. Do NOT leave a raised shoulder on screen-right. Do NOT put the large two-rivet right pauldron on the left shield arm. The LEFT shoulder still has CLOTH, without that metal pauldron.
Right sword arm travels in FRONT of chest, mostly hidden by torso from this rear-left three-quarter view. Only its gloved hand emerges at LEFT of chest above shield. No arm across back. This is genuine torso rotation with sensible occlusion, not an extra left arm. Left shield arm remains left and lower.
Full size sword extends from right-hand NORMAL grip at left chest toward far LEFT, shallow downward angle, clearly visible above shield and waist. Original broad long blade, same helmet/cloak/armor/shield. No pommel beside neck.
Most important: LEFTWARD body turn and LEFTWARD head lean, RIGHT shoulder dropped and foreshortened, LEFT shield shoulder remains cloth. Compact waist-up rear character, angular bold outline and big flat shadow shapes like original. Single transparent PNG, no effects/text/ground.

Edit this sprite, preserving its correct left shield arm and the sword arm going in FRONT of the body. Change the upper-body action: lean the chest, neck and helmet forcefully toward screen-LEFT, with helmet clearly LEFT of the waist center. Rotate the upper body into the cut so the far RIGHT shoulder is DOWN and FORWARD, not up beside the head. The ragged cloak and attached far-side right shoulder plate follow that rotation; do not add a plate to the left shield shoulder. Lower the sword TIP to a shallow downward-left slash angle: tip slightly BELOW the sword hand, not above it. Keep the sword hand around chest height and the full broad blade visible. Right-hand normal grip. Shield stays LEFT in left hand. Same original armor, helmet, neck cloth, sword and wooden shield. Keep compact waist-up rear three-quarter character, bold outline/broad flat shadows, transparent 1448x1086 canvas. This is a leftward attack follow-through with the whole upper body driving it, not another held pose. No effects, no text.

Composition/registration correction to image 1 only. Image 2 is the original READY frame and dictates the character's SCALE and waist registration. Preserve image 1's inward ATTACK body mechanics and sword direction, not image 2's raised arm.
The ATTACK torso is much too far to the RIGHT and too large. Put its belt/waist center at the SAME canvas position as READY (about x700,y800 on 1448x1086), and bring head center LEFT of that waist, around x610,y280. Keep head the same size as READY. Keep the whole character compact, same costume and body proportions. This is a real leftward torso turn and lean with RIGHT shoulder dropping forward; same far-side right pauldron remains foreshortened, left shoulder stays cloth. Original shield stays anatomical LEFT.
Recompose the sword arm and full broad sword to fit: sword hand at screen x460,y470, sword blade tip screen x40,y610 (a shallow downward-left cut), preserving original sword's substantial width and length in perspective. Correct normal grip and forearm travels in FRONT of chest, naturally hidden from rear three-quarter view. Do not leave the hilt by the neck. No mirrored anatomy, no extra arms or shoulder armor.
Don't translate a frozen torso; redraw the leftward action with waist anchored like READY. Transparent 1448x1086, single waist-up sprite, original bold black outline and broad flat angular shading. No text or effects.

첫 번째 그림은 워리어의 Ready 원본입니다. 이 캐릭터가 검을 오른쪽 위에서 왼쪽 아래로 베어낸 직후의 Attack 한 장을 새로 그리세요. 두 번째 사진은 실제 베기에서 몸통과 어깨가 함께 돌아가는 동세 참고입니다. 사진의 인물이나 복장은 그리지 마세요.
가장 중요: 원본과 같은 카메라/허리 위치/크기로 그립니다. 캐릭터의 허리가 캔버스 가운데에 있어야 하며, 머리는 원본보다 왼쪽으로 기울어야 합니다. 화면 오른쪽으로 캐릭터를 몰아넣지 마세요.
베면서 오른쪽 어깨가 앞으로 내려오고 몸통이 왼쪽으로 돌아간 연속 동작입니다. 검 든 오른팔은 가슴 앞을 지나므로 후면에서는 몸통에 일부 가려집니다. 오른쪽 금속 어깨판도 아래·앞으로 돌아가 납작하게 보입니다. 어깨판을 그대로 높이 세워 두지 마세요. 왼팔은 원래대로 화면 왼쪽의 방패를 들고 있으며 왼쪽 어깨에는 천이 있습니다. 어깨판을 왼팔로 옮기거나 캐릭터를 좌우 반전하지 마세요.
검 든 오른손은 몸 왼쪽의 가슴 높이로 나와 있고, 칼은 거기서 왼쪽으로 완만하게 내려갑니다. 칼을 목 옆에 붙이지 마세요. 정상적인 정수 그립, 원본 크기의 넓고 긴 검이며 원근에 맞게 약간 앞쪽을 향해도 됩니다. 화면 안에 머리·몸통·방패·검이 모두 보여야 합니다.
원본의 철 투구, 노란 목천, 올리브색 낡은 망토, 어두운 갑옷, 나무 방패 디자인과 굵은 먹선/큰 명암 면을 유지합니다. 머리와 몸통을 새로 크게 만들지 마세요. 진짜 투명 배경, 1448x1086, 허리 위 후면 게임 스프라이트 한 장. 글자·잔상·이펙트 없음.

Use image 1 as the EXACT ATTACK pose/layout guide, and image 2 as the Warrior's exact identity/style reference. This is a finished game sprite, not a diagram. Replace the guide shapes with the original Warrior's same head, cloak, armor, sword and shield, keeping the guide's joint positions and leftward lean. Ignore labels; draw no text. True transparent background, 1448x1086.
The pose guide deliberately keeps waist centered, head leaning LEFT, RIGHT shoulder much LOWER and pushed forward on screen-right, and right sword arm crossing IN FRONT of torso (hidden by cloak from rear view). Right sword hand emerges on the LEFT of chest, above the separate LEFT shield arm. The metal two-rivet RIGHT shoulder plate must stay at guide's gray plate on the RIGHT of the torso, never move onto the cloth-covered LEFT shield shoulder. This specific anatomy/layout is essential.
Normal sword grip, original full broad iron blade projects LEFT and slightly DOWN like the guide. Original wooden shield on LEFT forearm, same shield hand direction. Preserve original rear helmet design, ochre scarf, ragged olive cloak, dark metal armor and compact proportions. Bold rough black outline, broad flat angular shadow shapes. Extend torso ragged waistcloth to same lower framing as original. No ground, effects, motion trails, diagram strokes, labels or reference people. Single production Attack sprite.

Keep this connected Attack pose and its correct two-arm anatomy: LEFT shield arm, RIGHT sword arm passing in front of torso and emerging above shield; lowered far RIGHT shoulder plate, shallow down-left sword. Correct ONLY its composition and the stray blue color:
Recompose the character's BODY toward the LEFT so waist and helmet align with original Ready registration. The rightmost 25 percent of the canvas must be EMPTY TRANSPARENT SPACE. Do not fill the right edge with the cloak or hip. Leave a broad transparent margin on the right. Keep same head size and torso scale, but place waist nearer center and helmet LEFT of center. Sword tip stays near left canvas edge; foreshorten sword slightly if needed to keep full original-size broad blade visibly in frame. Compact ragged cloak and waist cloth, no long rightward cape tail.
Replace the blue patch beside sword/shield with the same dark charcoal iron/leather as original armor. No new colors. Preserve the shoulder plate on anatomical RIGHT, not left; no mirroring. Same costume and normal sword grip. True transparent 1448x1086 sprite with broad EMPTY RIGHT MARGIN. No text/effects.

Very small local correction to this finished Attack sprite. Keep the exact torso twist, lowered RIGHT shoulder, helmet position, centered waist, cloth LEFT shoulder, LEFT shield arm, cloak folds, scale and broad empty transparent RIGHT margin unchanged.
Raise ONLY the sword hand, its visible wrist and sword by about 120 pixels to UPPER CHEST height, just below the helmet's bottom, so the weapon stays readable in the game's upper-body crop. The sword remains a normal-grip right-hand weapon passing in FRONT of the torso. Its far right shoulder remains dropped forward; do NOT raise/recoil that shoulder. Let forearm be naturally occluded by the torso, with fist emerging above the shield.
Blade is full sized and broad, pointing LEFT with a shallow DOWNWARD angle, tip slightly below hilt. Do not shrink sword. Do not change any armor identity or move the right shoulder plate to left. Single transparent 1448x1086 sprite; no effects/text.

Correct ONLY the sword HILT and right-hand GRIP in this sprite, leaving all body pose, shield, shoulder plate, helmet, framing, sword blade size/angle and transparency exactly unchanged.
The sword is nearly horizontal pointing LEFT. Therefore blade, handle passing THROUGH the fist, and pommel must form ONE straight near-horizontal axis. Keep the vertical crossguard at the LEFT of the fist. A straight brown cylindrical handle extends RIGHT through the fist; a small round iron pommel is visibly at its RIGHT end. The blade exits the thumb/index side (LEFT side) of a NORMAL sword grip; the pommel exits little-finger side (RIGHT side). Fingers wrap the horizontal handle naturally. Remove the stray gray diamond ABOVE the fist: a pommel above the fist would break the weapon axis. Do not draw the handle vertically in the fist. Wrist connects naturally to forearm below/front, not blade.
Keep sword at current upper-chest height, shallow down-left angle. No moving body or cloak, no mirroring, no extra arm. Preserve the empty right margin and original broad angular outline/shading. Transparent PNG.
